title: Gemini API

body.text: Developers call Gemini in their apps via the
Gemini API: it supports text, images, audio, video, and function calling
— with a free tier to try and SDKs in several languages (Python, JS, Go).

example: "A restaurant app sends a receipt photo to the Gemini API to extract the items and prices as JSON automatically"

title: The structure of a call

body.text: The core of using the API:
choose the model → send contents (text/files) → set the config (temperature, max tokens, response format)
— you can set the response to a JSON schema, so the result is ready to use in your code immediately.

example: "config: { responseMimeType: 'application/json', responseSchema: {...} } — always get JSON matching the schema, no text parsing needed"

question: What input does the Gemini API support?
What's the benefit of setting the response to a JSON schema?

options.text: The result is usable in code immediately, no parsing needed

question: Do you have to pay before trying the Gemini API?

options.text: No, there's a free tier to try

question: To have your app use Gemini's capabilities, what should you use?
